question.prompt: How many integer values of \(x\) satisfy \(|x| \lt 3\pi?\)

solutions.title: Count distances from zero
solutions.explanation:
The absolute value \(|x|\) measures distance from \(0\), so we need the integer distances allowed by the bound \(3\pi\).

Since \(3\pi\approx9.42\), we have \(9<3\pi<10\). Thus the possible integer distances are \(0,1,\ldots,9\). Each positive distance \(d\) gives two values, \(x=d\) and \(x=-d\), while distance \(0\) gives only \(x=0\).

The total is
\[
2\cdot9+1=\boxed{19},
\]
which is choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
